text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen from 104,325 to 91,489, so I should review whether my overall risk and stock allocations still suit my goals rather than ignore the trend.","Monthly rebounds have been small and uneven; I should not assume a brief recovery means losses are over or try to time the market.","Since I rarely trade, I should use a simple periodic review and make deliberate changes only when the reasons are clear, while keeping enough cash for flexibility."]}
